using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int NN = 1 << 7;

int n;
int p[NN][NN];
int prob[NN][NN];
int popcnt[NN];
int id[NN];
vector<int> byCnt[NN];
ll q[NN][NN];

struct CustomHash {
    static uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {
        x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
        x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
        return x ^ (x >> 31);
    }
    size_t operator()(const pair<int, ll>& key) const {
        static const uint64_t FIXED_RANDOM = chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count();
        return splitmix64((uint64_t)key.second + FIXED_RANDOM) ^ (uint64_t)key.first;
    }
};
unordered_map<pair<int, ll>, int, CustomHash> memo;

int power(int a, int e, int m, int ans = 1) {
    for (; e; e >>= 1, a = (ll)a * a % m)
        if (e & 1) ans = (ll)ans * a % m;
    return ans;
}

int calc(int step, ll state) {
    if (state == 0) return 0;
    if (step == n) return 1;

    auto key = make_pair(step, state);
    auto it = memo.find(key);
    if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;

    int ans = 0;
    for (int choose = 1; choose < (1 << n); ++choose) {
        ll nxt = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < (int)byCnt[step].size(); ++idx) {
            if (((state >> idx) & 1LL) == 0) continue;
            int cur = byCnt[step][idx];
            int after = choose - (choose & cur);
            nxt |= q[cur][after];
        }
        ans = (ans + (ll)prob[step][choose] * calc(step + 1, nxt)) % MOD;
    }
    return memo[key] = ans;
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("in.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("out.out", "w", stdout);
#endif

    scanf("%d", &n);
    int inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            scanf("%d", &p[i][j]);
            p[i][j] = (ll)p[i][j] * inv100 % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int prod = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((mask >> j) & 1)
                    prod = (ll)prod * p[i][j] % MOD;
                else
                    prod = (ll)prod * (MOD + 1 - p[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
            prob[i][mask] = prod;
        }
    }

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        popcnt[mask] = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        byCnt[popcnt[mask]].push_back(mask);
        id[mask] = (int)byCnt[popcnt[mask]].size() - 1;
    }

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        for (int bit = 0; bit < n; ++bit) {
            if (!((mask >> bit) & 1))
                q[mask][1 << bit] = 1LL << id[mask | (1 << bit)];

        for (int sub = 1; sub < (1 << n); ++sub) {
            int low = sub & -sub;
            q[mask][sub] = q[mask][low] | q[mask][sub ^ low];
        }
    }

    cout << calc(0, 1) << '\n';
    return 0;
